Focused searches and checks of official Macnica/Macnica Galaxy company, ranking, milestones, and product disclosures resolved the claim’s components sufficiently for candidate review; remaining caveats concern independent verification of the ranking methodology and undisclosed revenue mix.

The Japan No. 1 ranking is stated by Macnica itself. Its footnote cites Gartner’s worldwide 2021 distributor market-share data on a revenue basis, but the underlying Gartner material and the Japan-specific calculation were not independently reviewed.
The official company sources confirm product representation and product examples, but do not disclose sales mix proving that these lines account for a majority of revenue.
Several official company and product pages do not display publication dates; periods are limited to dates explicitly stated on the pages or milestones.
